newsitem.title: BELGIUM: OLOs could test resistance, spread seen up.
newsitem.headline: OLOs could test resistance, spread seen up.

text.p: Belgian linear bonds lost all their early gains on Wednesday as Bund futures plunged though their uptrend support line around 101.60.
The OLO uptrend which started early in April was still intact at the close, but dealers said they expected the resistance line could be tested in early trade on Thursday.

The 2007 OLO yield closed at 5.90 percent, up two bp, while the OLO/Bund spread narrowed to five bps from nine as OLOs lagged the Bund futures selloff as they often do in bear markets. Dealers said they expected the spread to widen again as Belgium catches up with Germany.
Money market yields shot up in afternoon trade as the Belgian franc weakened to 20.6410/20 to the mark from 20.6405/10.
One-week repos were up 10 bp at 3.24/28, three-month T-bill yields were up two bp at 3.21/23 percent.
